correctness.rationale: The uniform-letter boundary flags are proved exactly independent Bernoulli variables; the previously published effective-swaps bijection reduces distinct outputs to independent sets. A three-state paired-matching transfer computes the second moment via a rational cubic recurrence for all lengths; exact direct enumeration independently confirms 35,778 word cases. Positive primitive matrices give their Perron growth rates, and the direct evaluation f_p(alpha^2)=p alpha (p-1)<0 proves strict variance inflation for all p=1-1/q. I.i.d. geometric cycles yield a renewal-reward strong law and CLT for log volumes; the geometric trailing-run remainder is negligible and the explicit variance is positive. Infinite identities and limit laws are mathematical arguments, not extrapolation of the checker.

value.rationale: The natural radius-one limited-permutation sphere is central to zero-error coding and packing. Existing results determine individual sizes and the first moment, but not how sizes fluctuate across random centers. Exact q-ary second moments, a strict exponential coefficient for relative variance, and a nondegenerate CLT for the logarithm identify a genuine typical-versus-average discrepancy and give rigorous distributional benchmarks for all word lengths and every fixed alphabet size. This is not a mere table extension or renaming, and no coding-rate consequence is asserted without proof.
